approvals.context: Individual weekday/weekend full-shift rates; separate bonus; approved work; accrued/paid/due; configurable amounts; no planned-shift accrual.

approvals.quote: Пусть сотрудник сам ставит то, что он сегодня, например, отработал, а директор или владелец должен подтвердить подтверждение, пойдет списание.
Если директор подтверждает, значит он подтверждает и выдачу денег.
approvals.effect: Supersedes accrual-only approval. One transaction records shift accrual AND already handed-over payment.

behavior: Employee submits only own actual full ordinary shift and sees own status, never salary data. Planned shifts do not accrue money.
Manager previews individual branch rate and cash/noncash method, attests actual payment, then confirms shift and payment atomically. CRM does not send money.
One active full shift per employee/civil work date; Saturday/Sunday weekend; branch date/timezone snapshot. No invented holiday or hourly calculation.
Immutable snapshot stores amount, rate/version, date/timezone, method and approver. Later rate changes affect future confirmations only.
Separate bonus accrual and explicit recorded payout; accrued/paid/due per branch, employee and currency. Overpayment denied.
Paired correction reverses shift accrual and payment together, preserves original rows; rejected/reversed claims may be resubmitted. No deletion.

architecture.ledger: Existing financial_transactions extended with payroll dimensions; no second money ledger.
architecture.customerFinancialSurfaces: Payroll excluded from customer/order revenue, debt, deposit, cash journal/export and generic reversals. Payroll paid amounts are shown in manager payroll view, not consolidated customer cash totals.
architecture.permissions: Existing registry unchanged. OWNER/DIRECTOR + financial visibility; STAFF_EDIT for rates; SHIFT_MANAGE + PAYMENT_CREATE for confirmation; SHIFT_MANAGE for rejection; PAYMENT_CREATE for bonus/payout; PAYMENT_REVERSE for correction; branch access enforced. Own claims use SHIFT_VIEW without manager rights.
architecture.privacy: Salary details absent from employee DTO and general audit metadata. New tables RLS enabled and PUBLIC/anon/authenticated privileges revoked.
architecture.currencyAndRates: Organization default currency; explicit positive integer amounts only; no prefilled rates or historical conversation amounts.

service: Own claim only; plan does not accrue; duplicate submission and future/cross-branch/tenant denied
Manager financial/branch permissions gate rates and approval; missing/inactive/unknown methods and missing rates write nothing
Atomic weekday approval creates one accrual and one actual-payment record under concurrent double-click
Weekend rate, stale preview rejection, and later rate change cannot rewrite confirmed snapshots
Failure of second posting rolls back both financial rows, claim and audit
Confirmed shift correction reverses paired postings atomically; no hard deletion; resubmission is possible
Separate bonus and payout track due balance; overpayment and removing paid accrual denied; reversals preserve history
Salary hidden from employee responses and customer finance surfaces; existing revenue/deposit/cash dimensions unchanged
Private RLS tables and database-level payroll balance/reversal integrity remain enforced
compatibility: Existing customer charge/payment/refund/deposit/withholding/reversal survive payroll guards with unchanged effects
browser: Employee mobile claim retains invalid date/key; corrected double-submit creates one own pending claim with no money posting
Owner previews new rate and noncash method; confirmation creates exactly one accrual/payment pair
Later rate setting changes do not rewrite approved amount shown in claim history
Separate bonus and recorded partial payout update remaining balance; mobile manager layout fits 390px
Manager correction UI reverses both shift entries while preserving originals
Employee sees own correction status only and direct manager payroll URL redirects away
Director cannot open payroll of inaccessible branch

quality.fix: Replace BigInt literals with BigInt(0); type customer-only label dictionaries as partial enum records. No business behavior change.

validation.initialAttempts: Service test initially exposed NULL-vs-zero aggregate test expectation, normalized empty aggregate; browser first attempt failed before mutation on selector escaping. Final complete runs passed. Initial typecheck failed on BigInt literals and enum label typing, then resumed successfully after compatibility-only fixes.

limits: Full standard shifts only; partial shifts, overtime, public-holiday rules excluded.
No taxes, contributions, deductions, penalties, sales percentages, bank transfers or legal payroll compliance claim.
UI claim history is paginated 50 per page; own recent history and manager ledger show latest 100; balances use full history.
Local database is synthetic, not a copy of live owner data. Browser authentication sessions were cleaned after tests; normal login remains required.
This release requires separate explicit approval for migrations and Production. Existing READY incident hotfix approval does not cover payroll.
